checkoutReview.conclusion: Announcements explicitly checks out the PR head. Packaged scope and final gate use default event checkout; five packaged smoke matrix jobs explicitly use the PR head. Complete accounting is 42 head, 5 event, 1 no-checkout aggregate.
checkoutReview.syntheticMerge: Actual future merge SHA, both parents and tree must be captured; real ancestor topology supports a source-equivalent tree but does not predeclare an observed merge identity.
checkoutReview.mutableInput: The two Stage1 static jobs also checkout mutable main for .current-product-lock/runtime.lock.json. Its actual source commit and lock bytes are a separate input.

Three settings regressions and one renderer regression were added while preserving all earlier cases.
